anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
AI system metrics show no recent learning cycles, zero average confidence, and no opportunities generated, suggesting the AI component may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics indicate no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual given the active strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially restart the AI system to ensure it is correctly identifying and acting on trading opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and adjust parameters or strategies to increase trade activity.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is crucial for identifying trading opportunities; its inactivity could result in missed opportunities and reduced profitability.

recommendations.action: Review the configuration and performance of active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions.
recommendations.rationale: Active strategies should be generating trades; their inactivity may indicate misalignment with market conditions or configuration issues.
